'''Qaras''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Jessar]] [[Species/Legends|species]] as well as the [[Minyavish]]. In [[44 ABY]], the Minyavish were revolted against by the Jessar, led by [[Rokari Kem]]. The Minyavish were then forced to leave the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Qaras was then accepted into the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], with Rokari Kem serving as the planet's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]].
